summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with coordinates in the unpadded frame, plus docstring updates; set_rnd skips __-prefixed attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; math replaced by numpy ceil; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array). Nothing was run, per instructions, so the pinned test values are unverified. Test images are assumed to be two np.arange(16) arrays, which the spec leaves unspecified. Both setUp and test_loading_array call set_determinism(1234). Nothing was committed.
